conditions.displayName: 3 or more failed readiness checks in 5 min

documentation.content:
An instance answered /readyz with 503 three or more times in five minutes: it cannot reach the database. The body says nothing on purpose; the `readiness check failed` line carries the driver's error and the request trace.

`gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="loop-sessions" AND jsonPayload.message="readiness check failed"' --limit=10 --freshness=30m` for the error text. Then `gcloud sql instances describe loop-sessions --format='value(state,settings.activationPolicy)'` (expect RUNNABLE, ALWAYS), and `gcloud run services describe loop-sessions --region=<region> --format='value(spec.template.metadata.annotations)'` to confirm the Cloud SQL connector annotation still names the instance. A wrong DATABASE_* variable fails at boot, not here; a socket that stopped answering fails here.

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-cloudsql
